# Third-party browser libraries

The geometry upload feature vendors these open-source libraries so files can be parsed locally in the browser without uploading them to a server.

- **shpjs 6.2.0** — MIT — https://github.com/calvinmetcalf/shapefile-js
- **fflate 0.8.2** — MIT — https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
- **GeoPackage JS 4.2.9** (`@ngageoint/geopackage`) — MIT — https://github.com/ngageoint/geopackage-js
- **node-unrar-js 2.0.2** — MIT — https://github.com/YuJianrong/node-unrar.js

Full license texts are included under `vendor/licenses/`.
